# AppBar

The app's lilac top bar: back button, title (or the lockup on the home screen), progress for flows, a shallow wave with a line stroke. One bar stays put while screens change.

- Lilac fill; the wave (bar.wave) is outlined in bar.line.
- Persistent: its parts animate, it never rebuilds.
